- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Mt. Takao has several trails: Omotesando Trail (easy), Inariyama Trail (moderate), Takaosanguchi Trail (moderate), Katsura Trail (easy), and Summit Trail (challenging).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Omotesando Trail: Distance 3.8 km, Elevation gain 500 m, Time 2-3 hours.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Inariyama Trail: Distance 2.5 km, Elevation gain 400 m, Time 1.5-2 hours.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Takaosanguchi Trail: Distance 4.5 km, Elevation gain 600 m, Time 3-4 hours.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Katsura Trail: Distance 2 km, Elevation gain 200 m, Time 1 hour.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Summit Trail: Distance 1.5 km, Elevation gain 300 m, Time 2 hours.
